import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:PiliPlus/models_new/video/video_play_info/subtitle.dart';
import 'package:PiliPlus/models_new/video/video_play_info/view_point.dart';
import 'package:PiliPlus/utils/path_utils.dart';
import 'package:PiliPlus/utils/subtitle_utils.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart' show compute;
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:path/path.dart' as path;

void main() {
  test('cached subtitles retain their local path and convert to VTT', () async {
    final directory = await Directory.systemTemp.createTemp('offline-subtitle-');
    addTearDown(() async {
      await directory.delete(recursive: true);
    });
    final cached = LocalSubtitle.fromCache([
      {'id': 7, 'lan': 'en', 'lan_doc': 'English'},
      {'id': 9, 'lan': 'zh-CN', 'lan_doc': 'Chinese'},
    ], directory.path)!;
    expect(cached.map((subtitle) => subtitle.lan), ['zh-CN', 'en']);
    expect(
      cached.first.path,
      path.join(directory.path, PathUtils.subtitleDir, '9${PathUtils.subtitleExt}'),
    );
    final file = File(cached.first.path);
    await file.parent.create(recursive: true);
    await file.writeAsString(jsonEncode({
      'body': [
        {'from': 1.0, 'to': 2.5, 'content': ' offline caption '},
      ],
    }));
    final data = jsonDecode(await file.readAsString()) as Map<String, dynamic>;
    final vtt = await compute<List, String>(SubtitleUtils.json2Vtt, data['body'] as List);
    expect(vtt, 'WEBVTT\n\n00:00:01.000 --> 00:00:02.500\noffline caption');
  });

  test('cached viewpoints become bounded playback segments', () {
    final points = ViewPoint.fromCache([
      {'type': 2, 'from': 10, 'to': 30, 'content': 'Chapter', 'imgUrl': 'image'},
      {'type': 2, 'from': 50, 'to': 90, 'content': 'End'},
    ])!;
    final first = points.first.toSegment(60);
    expect(first.end, 0.5);
    expect(first.from, 10);
    expect(first.to, 30);
    expect(first.title, 'Chapter');
    expect(first.url, 'image');
    expect(points.last.toSegment(60).end, 1.0);
  });
}
